system.bane: Aesthetic Fixation: Become fixated on beautiful things.

system.description: Become avatar of perfection, command absolute deference

system.appearance: Lucien is elegant in the Old World style - impeccably tailored suits (Brioni, bespoke), silver hair swept back, pale calculating eyes that never quite meet others' gaze directly. Thin hands with long fingers (pianist's hands, artist's hands). Every detail curated: pocket squares, cufflinks, fountain pens. He looks like museum piece - beautiful, valuable, fragile.

headers.concept: Declining Prince clinging to cultural prestige while real power slips away
headers.touchstones:
The Art Gallery of Ontario: Art and culture define civilization

Sabine Moreau: Reputation is everything

The Six Traditions: Tradition preserves order
